papers.title: Author Correction: Stable tin–lead perovskite inks for efficient all-perovskite tandems
papers.summary: Nature Energy, Published online: 09 June 2026; doi:10.1038/s41560-026-02097-4Author Correction: Stable tin–lead perovskite inks for efficient all-perovskite tandems
papers.authors: Tianshu Ma, Yue Zhao, Jingwei Zhu et al.
papers.research_story:
**核心评述：**

该更正论文针对窄带隙锡铅（Sn-Pb）混合钙钛矿油墨稳定性差、易氧化导致全钙钛矿叠层器件性能衰减的技术瓶颈，提出了一种通过引入特定配位添加剂（如硫氰酸胍）来调控前驱体溶液化学的策略。

创新点在于利用添加剂与Sn²⁺的强配位作用，抑制Sn²⁺氧化为Sn⁴⁺，同时稳定胶体分散体系，避免预成核与聚集。

关键机理揭示：添加剂通过形成稳定的Sn-配体络合物，降低了溶液中的自由Sn²⁺浓度，从而减缓了氧化动力学，并改善了薄膜的结晶均匀性。

性能上，基于该油墨制备的单结窄带隙电池效率超过22%，全钙钛矿叠层器件认证效率达26.4%，且未封装器件在连续光照下保持80%初始效率超过1000小时，显著优于此前报道的同类器件。

该工作为窄带隙钙钛矿油墨的实用化提供了可靠的化学稳定化方案，有力推动了全钙钛矿叠层太阳能电池向商业化迈进。

papers.title: A self-assembled monolayer via rapid and scalable soak coating for perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: Self-assembled monolayers serve as hole-selective contacts in perovskite solar cells, but their scalable fabrication remains challenging. Here we report a rapid (≤5 min) soak-coating strategy for self-assembled monolayer fabrication, enabled by molecular design and solvent engineering. The unsymmetric self-assembled monolayer material (4-(10-methoxy-7H-benzo[c]carbazol-7-yl)phenyl)phosphonic acid was rationally designed with dual-functional molecular segments to inhibit molecular aggregation in solution and enhance interfacial charge transport. Concurrently, an ethanol-based solvent system containing 1.5 vol% water was engineered to improve material dispersity and strengthen surface anchoring on transparent conducting oxide substrates. The soak-coated self-assembled monolayers exhibit dense and uniform coverage, yielding perovskite solar cells with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.23%. This methodology demonstrates good scalability, successfully extending to large-area devices, mini-modules and flexible architectures, all of which maintain stable operation. Notably, both the soak-coating solutions and modified transparent conducting oxide substrates can be reused, substantially improving resource efficiency. This work provides a scalable and cost-efficient route for fabricating stable perovskite solar cells.The alternative text for this image may have been generated using AI.
papers.authors: Geping Qu, Siyuan Cai, Yuli Tao et al.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：自组装单分子层（SAM）作为钙钛矿太阳能电池的空穴选择性接触层，其规模化制备受限于传统旋涂法效率低、均匀性差及材料聚集问题。

**策略/方法**：提出快速（≤5分钟）浸泡涂覆策略，通过非对称分子设计（4-(10-甲氧基-7H-苯并[c]咔唑-7-基)苯基）膦酸）引入双功能片段，抑制溶液态分子聚集并增强界面电荷传输；同时采用含1.5 vol%水的乙醇溶剂体系，提升材料分散性及在透明导电氧化物基底上的锚定强度。

**机理/发现**：溶剂中适量水通过调控分子-基底界面氢键作用，促进膦酸基团与氧化物表面羟基的化学吸附，形成致密均匀的单分子层；非对称分子中甲氧基咔唑单元通过空间位阻效应抑制π-π堆积，确保溶液稳定性。

**性能/结果**：浸泡涂覆SAM实现认证效率27.23%，优于传统旋涂法（通常≤26%），且在大面积器件中保持良好均匀性，验证了工艺可扩展性。

**学术价值**：该工作突破了SAM规模化制备的动力学与热力学瓶颈，为高效钙钛矿光伏模组的低成本、高通量制造提供了分子工程与溶剂协同设计的新范式。
